settings.record_color.label: Record color
settings.chapter_color.label: Chapter ring color
settings.chapter_color.description: Rings on the record where the chapters of a YouTube video start.
settings.progress_color.label: Progress ring color
settings.progress_color.description: The ring around the record that shows how much has played.
settings.chapters.label: YouTube chapters
settings.chapters.description: Chapter rings on the record and needle snapping to them. When off, the player never contacts YouTube.
settings.swap_animation.label: Record swap animation
settings.swap_animation.description: The old record slides out and the new one slides in when the album or video changes. On a move to a track from the same album the record lifts and turns over.
settings.player_color.label: Player color
settings.player_color.description: The turntable's body, the arm base and rest.
settings.players.label: Only players
settings.players.description: Parts of player names, such as firefox or vlc (playerctl -l lists them). Empty means any player.
settings.ignored_players.label: Ignored players
settings.ignored_players.description: Players the widget never shows, even when they match Only players.
